daas-irab:1-4.t: ﴿وَالْفَجْرِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb, its implied form being "أقسم" (I swear); ﴿وَلَيالٍ﴾: conjoined to الفجر. ﴿عَشْرٍ﴾: naʿt (adjective) of ليال; ﴿وَالشَّفْعِ وَالْوَتْرِ﴾: both also conjoined to الفجر; ﴿وَاللَّيْلِ﴾: also conjoined; ﴿إِذا﴾: an adverb of time; ﴿يَسْرِ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is in the position of a genitive by annexation (iḍāfa).

daas-irab:5-5.t: ﴿هَلْ﴾: a particle of affirmation (taqrīr); ﴿فِي ذلِكَ﴾: fronted khabar (predicate); ﴿قَسَمٌ﴾: postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿لِذِي﴾: naʿt (adjective) of قسم; ﴿حِجْرٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the nominal clause is the answer to the oath.

daas-irab:6-6.t: ﴿أَلَمْ تَرَ﴾: the hamza is a particle of affirmative interrogation, and an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by lam, the fāʿil (agent) being latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿كَيْفَ﴾: an interrogative noun, ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ﴾: a past verb and its agent; ﴿بِعادٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the verbal clause stands in place of the two objects of تر.

daas-irab:7-7.t: ﴿إِرَمَ﴾: badal (substitute) for عاد; ﴿ذاتِ﴾: naʿt (adjective), muḍāf to ﴿الْعِمادِ﴾.

daas-irab:8-8.t: ﴿الَّتِي﴾: a second naʿt (adjective) of إرم; ﴿لَمْ يُخْلَقْ﴾: لم is a particle of the jussive, and a passive imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by lam; ﴿مِثْلُها﴾: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); ﴿فِي الْبِلادِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause).

daas-irab:9-9.t: ﴿وَثَمُودَ﴾: conjoined to عاد; ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: naʿt (adjective) of ثمود; ﴿جابُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذي; ﴿الصَّخْرَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿بِالْوادِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb.

daas-irab:10-10.t: ﴿وَفِرْعَوْنَ﴾: conjoined to what precedes it; ﴿ذِي الْأَوْتادِ﴾: naʿt (adjective) of فرعون, muḍāf to الأوتاد.

daas-irab:11-11.t: ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: badal (substitute) for عاد, ثمود and فرعون; ﴿طَغَوْا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause); ﴿فِي الْبِلادِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb.

daas-irab:12-12.t: ﴿فَأَكْثَرُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it; ﴿فِيهَا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; ﴿الْفَسادَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

daas-irab:13-13.t: ﴿فَصَبَّ﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa; ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; ﴿رَبُّكَ﴾: the Name of Majesty [Translator's note: so in the source], fāʿil (agent); ﴿سَوْطَ عَذابٍ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), muḍāf to عذاب; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:14-14.t: ﴿إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَبِالْمِرْصادِ﴾: inna and its noun, and the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); ﴿بالمرصاد﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of inna; the clause gives the reason (taʿlīl).

daas-irab:15-15.t: ﴿فَأَمَّا﴾: the fāʾ is a resumptive particle and أما is a particle of condition and detailing; ﴿الْإِنْسانُ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿إِذا﴾: a conditional adverb that does not put the verb in the jussive; ﴿مَا﴾: redundant (zāʾida); ﴿ابْتَلاهُ﴾: a past verb and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿رَبُّهُ﴾: its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of a genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); ﴿فَأَكْرَمَهُ وَنَعَّمَهُ﴾: conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿فَيَقُولُ﴾: the fāʾ is the linking fāʾ (rābiṭa), and an imperfect verb whose agent is latent (mustatir); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿رَبِّي﴾: mubtadaʾ; ﴿أَكْرَمَنِ﴾: a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa; the nūn is the nūn of protection (wiqāya), and the omitted yāʾ of the first person is the direct object; the verbal clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is the maqūl (speech content) of the saying.

daas-irab:16-16.t: ﴿وَأَمَّا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction and أما is a particle of condition and detailing; ﴿إِذا﴾: a conditional adverb that does not put the verb in the jussive; ﴿مَا﴾: redundant (zāʾida); ﴿ابْتَلاهُ﴾: a past verb and its object, the fāʿil (agent) being latent (mustatir); the clause is in the position of a genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); ﴿فَقَدَرَ عَلَيْهِ﴾: conjoined to what precedes it; ﴿رِزْقَهُ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فَيَقُولُ﴾: the fāʾ is the linking fāʾ (rābiṭa), and يقول is an imperfect verb whose agent is latent; the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) and has no grammatical position. ﴿رَبِّي﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿أَهانَنِ﴾: a past verb; the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), and the omitted yāʾ of the first person is the direct object; the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is the maqūl (speech content) of the saying.

daas-irab:17-17.t: ﴿كَلَّا﴾: a particle of deterrence and rebuke; ﴿بَلْ﴾: a particle of digression (iḍrāb); ﴿لا﴾: negative; ﴿تُكْرِمُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), the wāw being its fāʿil (agent); ﴿الْيَتِيمَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:18-18.t: The verse is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:19-19.t: ﴿وَتَأْكُلُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿التُّراثَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿أَكْلًا﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); ﴿لَمًّا﴾: naʿt (adjective); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:20-20.t: Conjoined to what precedes it, and its i'rab is clear.

daas-irab:21-21.t: ﴿كَلَّا﴾: a particle of deterrence and rebuke; ﴿إِذا﴾: a conditional adverb that does not put the verb in the jussive; ﴿دُكَّتِ﴾: a passive past verb; ﴿الْأَرْضُ﴾: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is in the position of a genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); ﴿دَكًّا﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); ﴿دَكًّا﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq, a tawkīd (emphasis) of what precedes it.

daas-irab:22-22.t: ﴿وَجاءَ رَبُّكَ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it; ﴿وَالْمَلَكُ﴾: conjoined to ربك; ﴿صَفًّا صَفًّا﴾: two ḥāls (circumstantials).

daas-irab:23-23.t: ﴿وَجِيءَ﴾: a passive past verb; ﴿يَوْمَئِذٍ﴾: an adverb of time annexed to one like it; ﴿بِجَهَنَّمَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb, and they stand in the place of the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿يَوْمَئِذٍ﴾: an adverb of time annexed to one like it; ﴿يَتَذَكَّرُ الْإِنْسانُ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent); the verbal clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) and has no grammatical position. ﴿وَ﴾: the wāw is a resumptive particle; ﴿أَنَّى﴾: an interrogative noun in the position of a nominative as the fronted khabar (predicate); ﴿لَهُ﴾: attached to the omitted khabar; ﴿الذِّكْرى﴾: postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the nominal clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:24-24.t: ﴿يَقُولُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿يا﴾: a particle drawing attention (tanbīh); ﴿لَيْتَنِي﴾: a particle resembling the verb (one of inna and its sisters); the nūn is for protection (wiqāya) and the yāʾ is its noun; ﴿قَدَّمْتُ﴾: a past verb and its agent; the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of layta, and the nominal clause is the maqūl (speech content) of the saying; ﴿لِحَياتِي﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb.

daas-irab:25-25.t: ﴿فَيَوْمَئِذٍ﴾: the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and يومئذ is an adverb annexed to one like it; ﴿لا﴾: negative; ﴿يُعَذِّبُ﴾: an imperfect verb; ﴿عَذابَهُ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿أَحَدٌ﴾: fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:26-26.t: The clause is conjoined to what precedes it, and the i'rab is clear.

daas-irab:27-27.t: ﴿يا أَيَّتُهَا﴾: يا is a vocative particle, and the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), and ها is for drawing attention (tanbīh); ﴿النَّفْسُ﴾: badal (substitute); ﴿الْمُطْمَئِنَّةُ﴾: naʿt (adjective); the vocative clause is the maqūl (speech content) of an omitted verb of saying.

daas-irab:28-28.t: ﴿ارْجِعِي﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the yāʾ is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿إِلى رَبِّكِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; ﴿راضِيَةً مَرْضِيَّةً﴾: two ḥāls (circumstantials); the clause is likewise the maqūl (speech content) of an omitted verb of saying.

daas-irab:29-29.t: ﴿فَادْخُلِي﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the yāʾ is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿فِي عِبادِي﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:30-30.t: ﴿وَادْخُلِي﴾: an imperative verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿جَنَّتِي﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.
